papers.title: [Three-dimensional finite element modeling and biomechanical simulation for evaluating and improving postoperative internal instrumentation of neck-thoracic vertebral tumor en bloc resection].
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To employ three-dimensional finite element modeling and biomechanical simulation for evaluating the stability and stress conduction of two postoperative internal fixed modeling-multilevel posterior instrumentation ( MPI) and MPI with anterior instrumentation (MPAI) with neck-thoracic vertebral tumor en bloc resection. METHODS: Mimics software and computed tomography (CT) images were used to establish the three-dimensional (3D) model of vertebrae C5-T2 and simulated the C7 en bloc vertebral resection for MPI and MPAI modeling. Then the statistics and images were transmitted into the ANSYS finite element system and 20N distribution load (simulating body weight) and applied 1 N · m torque on neutral point for simulating vertebral displacement and stress conduction and distribution of motion mode, i. e. flexion, extension, bending and rotating. RESULTS: With a better stability, the displacement of two adjacent vertebral bodies of MPI and MPAI modeling was less than that of complete vertebral modeling. No significant differences existed between each other. But as for stress shielding effect reduction, MPI was slightly better than MPAI. CONCLUSION: From biomechanical point of view, two internal instrumentations with neck-thoracic tumor en bloc resection may achieve an excellent stability with no significant differences. But with better stress conduction, MPI is more advantageous in postoperative reconstruction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究颈胸椎肿瘤切除后的内固定稳定性，与髋关节植入物及股骨柄完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on cervical-thoracic spine instrumentation, not on hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or femoral stem mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估颈胸椎肿瘤切除术后内固定的稳定性和应力传导。
summary_zh.method: 基于CT建立C5-T2三维有限元模型，模拟全椎体切除并比较两种内固定方案。
summary_zh.result: 两种内固定均提供良好稳定性，但MPI在应力传导上更优。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the stability and stress conduction of two internal fixation methods after neck-thoracic vertebral tumor resection.
summary_en.method: 3D finite element models of C5-T2 were built from CT scans, simulating C7 en bloc vertebrectomy with MPI and MPAI.
summary_en.result: Both fixations achieved good stability, with MPI showing better stress conduction.
